g.text: WM-H/I/S/E -> local ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source and native gates OPEN

text.tspan: registration-and-writers
MAKEWILL prepends movable will to current PSTATE
nonexec list; raw field setters and explicit execution
are distinct managed writers
decision-and-rebuild
Testator must be memory allocated and unmarked; follow
forwarding before reading; preserve tagged next flags
and rebuild moved list heads
automatic-and-explicit
Current GC raises interrupt only on p0; finalizer pops
current PSTATE list; public explicit execution need
not wait for eligibility; Scheme owns action context
shutdown-and-real-users
Exit final-will FIFO is separate; real SQLite and
ephemeron callbacks mutate resources/state and require
explicit context and failure policy
processor-exit
Storage handoff does not transfer semantic weak
membership; creator exit must preserve both lists,
pending work and rooted action frames
weak-domain-transfer
Same VM weak-domain membership, not ordinary strong
RootRegistry payload; close producers and list
consumers; exact durable transfer before creator
cleanup
strong-decision-cut
Freeze strong reachability for every relevant
decision; prevent earlier weak marking from changing
later eligibility; cross-domain source refinement
remains open
moving-list-rebuild
Preserve per-origin list sequence and tag semantics;
rewrite heads and links after forwarding; keep weak-
derived work until completion receipt
dispatch-and-capture
Pop acquires rooted action frame; capture
testator/action before clearing; no safepoint in
unprotected pop-to-capture quantum; Scheme context
executes action
continuation-and-shutdown
Cleared fields forbid fresh dispatch of same payload
but continuations may repeat body effects; escaped
roots remain owned; no timeout-based retirement or
destructor equivalence
weak-membership
Positive work benefit only if removed
affinity/reconstruction exceeds metadata; all required
weak scans remain
action-ownership
May reduce critical-path affinity; arbitrary action
context, resource ordering and escaped frames can
negate parallel gain
single-authority
Modern C can express full contract; Zig supplies no
demonstrated unique semantic saving; no speedup
asserted
